title: Autosmelter enchant
description: Ads an enchantment that smelts your items as you mine them. nice if you are low on cole or whatever
body:
# Content
This pack adds the Autosmelter enchantment wich can be applied on all picaxes
The enchantment is pretty self explanitory, but it aoutomaticly smelts items when mined such as raw iron drops as iron and raw gold drops as gold etc. This also works if the item drops multiple items such as copper can drop 1 - 4 copper and it will then smellt all of those drops.
# compatibility
## silk touch
The item cannot be aplied with silk touch
## Fortune
### Aoutosmelt I
This lvl is not compatible with fortune
### Autosmelt II
Is compatible with Fortune 


# Why
This Pack is made as a Vanilla+ style pack
it ads a vanillafriendly autosmelt enchantment.
## Levels
The different levels are meant for different staidums of the game.
### Lvl I
This enchantment is meant for earlygame saving. It saves you a lot of coal during the earlygame

### Lvl II
Lvl 2 is more for the late game and works with fortune, this lvl is a lot more difficult to aquire
